turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Mr. Hale. Meredith Kalinowski. Owen's mother.

I got your message about the zero. After the zero was already entered.

I have about twenty minutes. I'd like to use them well.

Tell me exactly what you have. What did the checker flag, and when did you run it?
Look, I'll own it if I messed up.

I appreciate you saying that. It doesn't change anything yet.

I don't need you to own it. I need to see it.

What date did you run the essay through the checker? Which tool? What was the exact output?

And what else do you have besides a 94%?
Walk me through exactly what I did wrong with Owen's case. Step by step.

I'm not here to audit you. But I'll tell you what I know.

You entered the zero. Then you called me. That's the order.

Owen says he wrote it himself. I haven't seen anything that says otherwise.

What I haven't seen is the report. Or the date you ran it. Or any draft comparison.

So I can't tell you what you did wrong. I don't have your file. You do.

Show me what's in it.
